name: Bluetooth Adapter Switch
author: cesarfilho
description: Switch between the onboard Bluetooth adapter and a USB dongle from the bar, keeping exactly one active (a plugged-in dongle takes over automatically, and your headset reconnects). A panel shows each adapter and its devices: connect, pair, forget, battery, scan, music or call mode, and the sound follows the headset.

barWidget.description: Shows the active Bluetooth adapter and its devices, and lets you switch adapters, connect, pair and forget devices from a panel.

schema.label: Show adapter name next to the icon
Preferred adapter
schema.description: Which adapter is active when several are present, for example right after plugging in a dongle. Last used picks the adapter your last device was connected through.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Type shows USB or Onboard; Adapter id shows hci0, hci1.

schema.label: Scan for
schema.description: Headsets and speakers must be paired over Classic to carry audio. Use Low Energy for BLE-only devices such as some keyboards.

schema.label: Turn an adapter back on when all are off
schema.description: Keeps one adapter active at all times. Turn off if you want to switch Bluetooth off completely (for example with the rfkill key).

schema.label: Reconnect devices after the adapter changes
schema.description: When another adapter becomes active (dongle unplugged, Bluetooth switched back on), reconnect the devices you had connected, if they are paired to it.

schema.label: Low battery alert (%)
schema.description: Notify once when a connected device drops to this level, and show it in red. 0 turns the notification off.

schema.label: Connect timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long to wait for a device to answer before giving up.
